title: Add an AWS CDK stack
description: Add a stack with an example Lambda function to a CDK app created by `@wuguishifu/nx-aws-cdk:cdk-app`, and register it in the app's stage.

name.description: The name of the stack, e.g. `users`. Generates `UsersStack` in `src/stacks/users/`.
name.x-prompt: What is the name of the stack?

project.description: The CDK app project to add the stack to.
project.x-prompt: Which CDK app should the stack be added to?
